Publications

My publications investigate how AI capabilities can translate into useful and reliable systems in practice. Across industrial RAG, multimodal reasoning, evidence grounding, and agent memory, I often use explicit structure to preserve information that matters for downstream use. * denotes first or co-first author. See also Google Scholar.
